subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should the remaining fix be limited to heartbeat-session precedence, or should it also change Telegram DM default session isolation?
rationale: The source-backed bug is explicit `heartbeat.session` losing to an originating session, while making Telegram DMs default to per-peer isolation would change documented `session.dmScope: main` behavior.

options.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
options.body: Make explicit `heartbeat.session` win for wake-triggered heartbeats, preserve or migrate pending system events safely, and leave existing DM defaults unchanged.

options.title: Broaden to DM isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DM default session behavior with docs, migration/doctor guidance, and upgrade proof for users relying on main-session sharing.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Wait for a current-main Telegram heartbeat/exec-event reproduction before sponsoring a replacement PR.

recommendation.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
recommendation.body: Make explicit `heartbeat.session` win for wake-triggered heartbeats, preserve or migrate pending system events safely, and leave existing DM defaults unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: They owned the adjacent merged Telegram DM dedupe boundary that this issue explicitly follows up on.
